scripts.build:analyser: command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake make g++ binutils || (echo "apt-get not found – assuming cmake, make, g++ are already installed" && false); mkdir -p frontend/backend/bin && cd analyzer && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j && cp cma ../../frontend/backend/bin/linux-x64-cma
